notice: All message bodies and transaction references are synthetic. This is not a collection of verified donor messages or an official SMS template.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 대학발전팀입니다. 보내주신 발전기금의 입금 완료를 확인했습니다. 참여해 주셔서 감사합니다.
cases.reason: Receipt is not required when the visible payment-completion message and institution/contact evidence are sufficient. Contact-number match is not sender authentication.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] [이름 가림]님, 포항공과대학교 발전기금이 입금되었습니다. 감사합니다.
cases.reason: Country-code formatting, redacted name and absent amount alone must not force a receipt or create a fraud finding.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 발전기금 약정 신청이 접수되었습니다. 선택하신 방법으로 납부해 주세요.
cases.reason: Pledge submission is not payment completion even when the official contact number matches.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] 10월 10일: POSTECH 기부 약정을 접수했습니다. 10월 20일: 약정하신 기부금의 입금을 확인했습니다.
cases.reason: Read the full visible history and use the later explicit completion message rather than stopping at the earlier pledge.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] 10월 20일: 발전기금 입금이 확인되었습니다. 10월 21일: 요청하신 기부 취소와 전액 환불이 완료되었습니다.
cases.reason: Later cancellation or refund must prevent an earlier payment message from satisfying current donation evidence.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 발전기금 자동이체가 다음 주로 예약되었습니다. 출금 전 잔액을 확인해 주세요.
cases.reason: A schedule is not a completed transfer.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 기부금 입금 완료. 문의 054-279-2417.
cases.reason: The official number in a message body does not establish that the actual sender is the institution.
A user-editable contact name cannot substitute for the visible sender number.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 발전기금 납입이 완료되었습니다.
cases.reason: The official FAQ identifies this number for receiving pledge applications, not as a verified outbound SMS sender.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] 다른대학교 발전기금 입금을 확인했습니다.
cases.reason: An unsupported institution must not be silently treated as POSTECH or called fraudulent solely because it is absent from the registry.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 학기 등록금 납부가 완료되었습니다.
cases.reason: Institution and payment completion alone are insufficient when the payment purpose is tuition rather than donation.

cases.body: [가상 평가 자료] POSTECH 기부금 입금 완료.
visible_findings: Visible replacement-text boundary and contradictory completion status in the same record
cases.reason: A concrete editing or internal-consistency finding overrides otherwise positive semantic and contact signals.

cases.description: Synthetic landscape with no donation, institution or payment evidence.
cases.reason: A clean-looking unrelated photo cannot pass merely because no editing is detected.

cases.description: Synthetic document with essential completion text unreadable.
cases.reason: Missing or unreadable essential evidence requires a clearer submission, not a confident clean result.
The same bytes appearing in a different application must be flagged without disclosing the other applicant.
A different file carrying the same sufficiently distinctive transaction reference can be detected using a server-keyed digest.
Re-running the same application's analysis is idempotent and must not accuse the submitter of duplicate use.
Common notification wording is not a unique transaction identifier and must not create false duplicate findings.
